sloka: इदं विमानं वैदेहि पुष्पकं नाम नामतः ।दिव्यं त्वां धारयेन्नैवं यद्येतौ गतजीवितौ ।। ६.४८.२६ ।।।।
transliteration: idaṁ vimānaṁ vaidehi puṣpakaṁ nāma nāmataḥ ।divyaṁ tvāṁ dhārayennaivaṁ yadyetau gatajīvitau ।। 6.48.26 ।।।।

translations.english: "The army chief killed, the interest of the troop lost, Pushpaka will move about without making an effort like the ship which lost the helmsman."
